title: Trump convicted in New York hush-money trial
description: New York jury found Donald Trump guilty on all 34 counts in the hush-money trial.

title: Biden-Trump CNN presidential debate begins
description: CNN hosted the first 2024 general-election debate between Joe Biden and Donald Trump at 9 p.m. ET on June 27.

title: Trump injured in Butler rally shooting
description: Shots were fired while Donald Trump was speaking at a campaign rally in Butler Pennsylvania.

title: Trump selects JD Vance as running mate
description: Donald Trump selected Senator JD Vance as his 2024 vice-presidential running mate.

title: Biden withdraws and backs Harris
description: Joe Biden announced that he would leave the 2024 presidential race and endorsed Kamala Harris.

title: Harris selects Tim Walz as running mate
description: Kamala Harris announced Minnesota Governor Tim Walz as her vice-presidential running mate.

title: Harris-Trump ABC presidential debate begins
description: ABC hosted the first debate between Kamala Harris and Donald Trump at 9 p.m. ET on September 10.
